rows.en: ...As of today, custody of M-type Specimen No. 1 has been transferred to the Bahbem Foundation.
rows.notes: Custody report to Itsuki/Helena. Root research found no exact Akurasu designation; retained literal M-type Specimen No. 1. Akurasu RahXephon episode Human Specimen #1 is a different label and was not substituted.
uncertain: Exact licensed label unverified: M-type Specimen No. 1 is a source-literal designation. M is not expanded.

rows.en: Uncle's plan has taken another step forward. Hasn't it, Itsuki?

rows.notes: Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: ...Why don't you say something?
...What will happen to Ayato Kamina?
If he can't be raised as her mate, we can just send him to a detention camp. That counterfeit...
rows.notes: Isshiki disparages Ayato as counterfeit; mate refers to Quon from original nearby rows. Trailing source fragment retained.
Reaction only; source deliberate omission preserved.

rows.en: We have the original in our hands. ...Don't we?
Ra-ra?
rows.notes: Context settled from the original neighboring dialogue; complete spoken subject/action retained.

rows.en: ...I'm going away...
rows.notes: Quon announces departure; destination remains omitted as in source, supplied by Helena next.

rows.en: Yes, you're going back. To your real home.
Vanished!? Are you sure the Second Branch has vanished!?
...Our only lead is footage from a geostationary satellite. Nothing else remains, not even a trace.
First they suddenly tell me to bring Shinji and the others back... And now this? What a nightmare.
Evangelion Unit-04 and all associated research facilities within a 49-kilometer radius have vanished.
Judging by the schedule, we believe there was an accident while they were testing installation of the S2 Engine repaired in Germany.
There are 32,768 possible causes, from inadequate material strength to errors in the initial design. Sabotage is also a possibility.
But it wasn't an explosion. It vanished, right? So it just disappeared...
That's what happens when you insist on using something you don't understand.

rows.notes: Silence retained.

rows.en: And now the S2 Engine they went to all that trouble to repair is gone too.
Yes... The dream is shattered.
So what are we doing with the remaining EVA-03?
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: We're taking it in here. Apparently, they don't want to lose the First Branch as well.
They were the ones who insisted on the rights to build EVA-03 and EVA-04 and forced them through...!
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: Now they dump all the dangerous stuff on us? That's awfully convenient for them.
After a tragedy like that, anyone would lose their nerve. Thousands of people were caught in it.
So how are we handling EVA-03's activation test? Are we using that dummy thing?
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: Is that why you called Rei back?
I'll decide the details of EVA-03's test after I consult the commander.
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: This is the prototype Dummy Plug.
Rei's personality has been implanted in it.
But we can't digitize the human mind... the soul. It's only a fake... nothing more than a simulation.
rows.notes: Ritsuko distinguishes soul digitization from machine simulation; all qualifications retained.

rows.en: It's just a machine that imitates a human.
We feed the signal pattern into the EVA...
rows.notes: Trailing clause retained; following row gives intended EVA response.

rows.en: The EVA believes there's a pilot inside... All we need is for it to synchronize.
For now, load the data from EVA-01 and EVA-02.
But there are still unresolved problems with the experiments...
rows.notes: Trailing objection retained.

rows.en: It doesn't matter. As long as the EVA moves.
rows.notes: Gendo dismisses objection; second clause deliberately conditional fragment.

rows.en: ...Yes, sir.
I've entrusted EVA-03's transport entirely to the Federation Forces. It should arrive by the weekend.
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: I'll leave the rest to you.
Yes, sir. We'll carry out the adjustments and activation test at Matsushiro.
Who will be the test pilot?
The Dummy Plug is still too dangerous. From the current candidates...
rows.notes: Candidate-selection clause deliberately trails into Gendo next row.

rows.en: We'll choose a fourth child, then.
Yes. There's one child who could do it if we boost his physiological condition.
rows.notes: Physiological boosting is source-literal; selected child gender is established by Ritsuko row56.
uncertain: Source physiological boosting wording is unusual; translated literally without specifying procedure.

rows.en: I'll leave it to you.

rows.notes: Silence retained for all four original uses.

rows.en: Rei, you can get out now. Let's have a meal.
...Yes.
What's this? Why so formal?
The activation test for EVA-03 at Matsushiro... We'll use the fourth child as the test pilot.
rows.notes: Final terminology reconciliation: source numbered unit uses canonical EVA-03; EVA-04 follows numbered pattern without invented alternate proper name.

rows.en: A fourth child? You've found the Fourth Child?
rows.notes: Lowercase generic fourth child then canonical Fourth Child title matches source repetition.

rows.en: Only very recently...
rows.notes: Answers timing question elliptically; deliberate fragment retained.

rows.en: I haven't received any report from the Marduk Institute.
The official paperwork will arrive tomorrow.
Dr. Akagi... You're not hiding something from me again, are you?
Not really.
rows.notes: Evasive answer; not an absolute denial.

rows.en: Well, all right... So who is this child you've chosen?
It's him.
rows.notes: Deictic male reference retained without supplying Toji name.

rows.en: What...!? Isn't this boy Shinji's...!
rows.notes: Relationship to Shinji deliberately left unfinished; no invented friend noun.

rows.en: It can't be helped. We're gathering the candidates together to protect them.
It's hard to tell him... about this...
Asuka's fine. She takes pride in piloting an EVA.
Rei's an exception, of course... But nothing good comes of getting involved with us and the EVAs...
rows.notes: Rei exception scope retained; involved with both staff and EVAs.

rows.en: Shinji knows that better than anyone. I don't want to put him through any more pain.
But we need those children. If we're all going to survive.
Are you telling me... to drop the noble ideals?
rows.notes: Idiomatic moral euphemism for pretty ideals; source asks whether Ritsuko is telling Misato to abandon them. Semantic revision: removes invented hands-clean imagery; preserves question about abandoning pretty ideals.

rows.en: ...For now, Shinji and the others will stay here until the test is over.
Yes, I know.
Lieutenant Hadhiyat... Have you seen Ayato?
No... I'm the only one in this hangar right now.
Knowing Kamina, isn't he in his room painting?
He's not there, though. Maybe he's gone back to Rikudo's house...
This is a good opportunity, Major. Can't we remove Kamina from #部隊名?
rows.notes: Elvy asks Soichi to remove Kamina; Major rank from glossary; squad placeholder unchanged.

rows.en: Kamina isn't a soldier to begin with...
rows.notes: Trailing justification retained.

rows.en: If you put it that way, #部隊名 is all civilians helping us out of goodwill.
rows.notes: All cooperative civilians / goodwill retained; no claim of paid service. Final semantic refinement makes exclusive all explicit rather than draft full of.

rows.en: With this Vermillion, we can keep fighting without relying on RahXephon.
This machine can even break through the absolute barrier. With it, we have nothing to fear, even from the Mu.
rows.notes: Capability and fearless Mu comparison retained.

rows.en: ...TERRA has no need for the Vermillion.
...What do you mean...?
To put it plainly, that thing... TERRA has no need for it.
What did you say!?
Well, it's true! Whatever #部隊名 may be, TERRA isn't an army...
rows.notes: TERRA self-defense argument; squad placeholder retained verbatim. Semantic review: Changed opening to natural defensive challenge; no fit-driven shortening.

rows.en: Don't dodge the question! Are you saying you're not a soldier? Well, Major!?
Our sole purpose is self-defense. But the Vermillion is clearly a weapon built for invasion...!
Spare me your pretty words! Do you even understand the situation Earth is in!?
What we need now is the strength to defeat the enemy!
We need the strength to protect people, not defeat the enemy!
Then wasn't Operation Overlord an invasion!?
That operation was led by the Earth Federation Forces!
You were the ones who planned it!
I... opposed it!
Opposed it? You let it happen! You stood by and let my comrades die!
Do you know what we call someone like that!?
What!?
A hypocrite! That's what you are!
Then, with those missiles you fired inside TOKYO JUPITER...
rows.notes: Source sentence deliberately continues into95; preserve unfinished lead-in.

rows.en: How many people do you think you killed!?
People? They're Mulians!
rows.notes: Semantic review: Removed invented bastards swearword; source contempt remains in denial they are people.

rows.en: What's the difference!? Between Mulians and people!?
Of course there's a difference!
Between Ayato and you, too!?
rows.notes: Soichi uses Ayato as counterexample to Elvy's dehumanizing distinction; not asking whether both are Mulians.
Source lone surprise mark retained.

rows.en: Ah... no...
rows.notes: Backtracks after accidentally revealing Ayato's status; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: What... did you just say...?

rows.notes: Repeated silence in three original uses; no added subject or meaning.

rows.en: Hey! Did Kamina show a MU phase response!? Are you saying he's a Mulian!?
rows.notes: Elvy addresses Soichi about Kamina/Ayato; surname follows source. Semantic review: Source says response manifested; removed additional test-positive framing while preserving phase and response. Root term guidance: MU phase response; do not expand transformation diagnosis.
uncertain: Provisional literal MU phase response: root searched Akurasu exact designation and found no entry; independently licensed compound unverified. Source fictional designation retained.

rows.en: Was that why you summoned him this time!? To investigate that!? Answer me!!
Please... forget what I just said...!
rows.notes: Soichi asks Elvy to forget disclosure; request direction preserved.
Repeated silence is reused across several original scene positions.

rows.en: Kamina...
...I'm sorry.
Ayato!!
So... it's true...
Kamina is... a Mulian...
rows.notes: Stunned revelation; predicate completed in English while ellipses retained.

rows.en: I finally found you.
Yakumo... Is what you said earlier true?
What... am I?
You're you.
So I was the only one who didn't know...
Only a handful of people in TERRA know.
Really...? You were laughing behind my back, weren't you?
rows.notes: Ayato accuses people at TERRA of laughing behind his back.

rows.en: Saying, "He's a Mulian. He's not human"...
rows.notes: Fragment quotes the imagined mockery from117; not speaker claiming another person is nonhuman.

rows.en: You were just using me, weren't you? Because I can pilot the RahXephon...
rows.notes: Explicit listener subject restores accusation; no new motive beyond piloting RahXephon.

rows.en: ...I'm pathetic...
rows.notes: Next reply122 resolves self-criticism as Soichi, not Ayato.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Shared short reaction also occurs s0710:309 responding to Quon claiming they are human; Huh fits both.

rows.en: I don't mean you. I mean myself.
I'm pathetic... I don't even have the guts to give you a good slap at a time like this.
rows.notes: Self-criticism: Soichi lacks resolve to slap Ayato; no softening into scolding.

rows.en: Go ahead... I'm a Mulian anyway...
That doesn't matter. You're still you, aren't you? People...
rows.notes: Ends at People, interrupted by126; deliberate fragment preserved.

rows.en: I don't want to hear your twisted logic!
rows.notes: Ayato angrily rejects Soichi's reasoning as sophistry; excuses uses spoken register. Semantic review: Restores sophistry/false-reasoning meaning more precisely than broad excuses.

rows.en: ...People are connected to other people. That's why I can be here, too.
rows.notes: Returns to interrupted People thought125 after silence; explicit people connections retained.

rows.en: So you can stay here, too. As yourself...!
rows.notes: Soichi grants belonging as Ayato himself; no requirement to act differently.

rows.en: ...I'll go now... But please remember this... I think of you as one of us.
rows.notes: Nakama rendered one of us, preserving fellowship without importing family/romance.

rows.en: Ayato...
rows.notes: Haruka's emotional name-only response retained.

rows.en: Haruka...
...The sea is nice, isn't it...
rows.notes: Ayato deflects to sea rather than answering Haruka's concerns.

rows.en: Can't you trust me, either?
It's so vast, and it goes on forever...
rows.notes: Ayato continues describing the sea after ignoring trust question132.

rows.en: So that's how it is...
The waves come and go... Even after I'm dead...
rows.notes: Waves recur even after Ayato's future death; deliberate trailing subordinate clause.
Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: ...You knew, didn't you...?
Yes... but you're still you, aren't you?
You're saying the same thing as Yakumo.
You don't have to worry... MU or human, it doesn't matter. Really...
rows.notes: Reassurance trails at really; no added conclusion.

rows.en: The sea... goes all the way to Tokyo, doesn't it...
What's wrong!? Can't things stay the way they are!? We've been getting along just fine all this time!
Stop it!!
rows.notes: Source stray closing bracket and @ indent ignored as brief instructs.

rows.en: You've been fooling me just fine all this time, haven't you? Like that...
You took me out of Tokyo saying you'd show me the truth. Then you hid the truth, and I...!!
rows.notes: Ayato accusation deliberately trails at I; no invented result.

rows.en: If this is how it was going to be, I should have stayed in Tokyo!
Ayato...!
You...
rows.notes: Deliberate accusing fragment You before149.
Silent exclamation maintained.

rows.en: You're a liar...
"You"... huh...
rows.notes: Haruka echoes Ayato's distancing pronoun anata, contrasting habitual name address; English word retained.
uncertain: Anata carries distancing effect against name address; plain English you does not independently convey that contrast. Literal echo retained.

rows.en: That word, "you"... It sounds... pretty harsh...
rows.notes: Haruka comments on emotionally distancing anata. Literal pronoun kept; effect less idiomatic in English. Semantic review: Sounds makes explicit source comment on distancing address; no invented nickname substitution.
uncertain: Anata carries distancing effect against name address; plain English you does not independently convey that contrast. Literal echo retained.

rows.en: Oh, you're back. Honestly... You've only just come back to Nirai Kanai after so long, and you can't sit still.
rows.notes: Rikudo remarks Ayato is restless immediately after long absence; not concern that returning is wrong.

rows.en: Ollin...
rows.notes: Quon addresses Ayato with sourced nickname Ollin.

rows.en: Quon... Why are you here?
Well, then... I'm off to see an old friend. If you go out, make sure you lock up.
rows.notes: Rikudo asks Ayato to lock up conditionally if he goes out; request direction restored.

rows.en: I'm not going out.
I said... if.
rows.notes: Rikudo repeats conditional if; intentionally elliptical response.
Context settled from the original neighboring dialogue; complete spoken subject/action retained.

rows.en: Why are you smiling...?
Because I got to see you, Ollin...
rows.notes: Quon glad to see Ayato; Ollin is direct address.

rows.en: You knew too, didn't you? That's why you're smiling...
I'm a Mulian. My blood is really blue.
Then so am I.
What are you talking about?!
My blood is blue too.
Th-then... why did Itsuki say you were his sister...?!
Take me with you...
rows.notes: Quon asks Ayato to take her; direction restored.

rows.en: Everyone was talking to you like it was perfectly normal!
...I'm being called.
rows.notes: Caller deliberately unidentified; passive preserves source omission.

rows.en: How could they all act like everything was normal?!
To Tokyo...
rows.notes: Deliberate location fragment, continuing the request.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: I want you to take me to Tokyo.
I can't...
Why?
Because... the absolute barrier...
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted objection; barrier clause remains unfinished.

rows.en: Why? You came out of there, didn't you?
If you came out, you can go back. So why?
...I see.
Heh, so that's it... The absolute barrier was inside me.
rows.notes: Literal barrier becomes an inner psychological barrier; same term retained.

rows.en: ...I'd like to see Tokyo...
Because you want to.
rows.notes: Quon answers Ayato's desire rather than inventing a separate goal.
uncertain: Quon's omitted subject read as Ayato: she echoes his wish to see Tokyo. Speaker-self reading (because I want to) is also grammatically possible.

rows.en: The real Tokyo, the real me...
rows.notes: Deliberate fragment elaborates row179.

rows.en: There may not be any answers...
That's all right... That's all right with me...!
Are you leaving already?
It's calling me.
rows.notes: Calling source unspecified; impersonal it avoids an invented caller.

rows.en: I see...
Itsuki, what's going on here?!
Would you let her go?
rows.notes: This person resolves to Quon from departure exchange and her next thanks.

rows.en: Thank you, Brother.
Ayato! Ayato, why?!
...I'm sorry.
Don't apologize!
I'm sorry.
You want to find out the truth.
Huh...?
All of it, with your own eyes.
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation of row194, retaining source sentence division.

rows.en: Ayato...
I don't know what I'll see over there. But I intend to accept all of it.
Then I want to decide whether to live as Mu, or come back as a human...
rows.notes: Mu/human alternatives retained; decision follows accepting evidence.

rows.en: You're coming back to us!
As yourself, whether you're human or Mu!
rows.notes: Haruka insists on personal identity rather than species.

rows.en: You really are different from Yakumo, Haruka...
rows.notes: Source surname Yakumo retained, not expanded to Soichi.

rows.en: Do you really have to go...?
rows.notes: Restores leave/go from immediate departure context.

rows.en: I'm sorry.
All right... I believe in you.
I might betray you...
I'll still believe in you... Is that wrong?
...Itsuki.
What is it?
I'll protect your sister, no matter what. So please look after Haruka for me.
rows.notes: Ayato asks Itsuki to care for Haruka while Ayato protects Quon.

rows.en: I'm counting on you to look after my sister...
rows.notes: Itsuki entrusts his sister to Ayato; direction restored.

rows.en: Let's go, Ollin.
rows.notes: All uses reviewed: i071b:247 and s0710:385; shared wording suits both.

rows.en: Yeah.
Thank you...
...I'll be back...
rows.notes: Japanese departure formula implies return; rendered as a promise-like farewell.

rows.en: See you when you get back...
rows.notes: Responsive Japanese departure formula retains expected return, answering row214. Semantic refinement after complete draft, not fit compression.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Raideen or Vermillion is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat condition; preserves two explicit lines and either unit / allied mothership distinction.

rows.en: ! What happened?!
The R-RahXephon...! The RahXephon is launching from the temple!!
Impossible! No such order has been given!
Hurry! Match the pilot's brain waves!
Brain wave match confirmed...! It's Ayato... No, there's another one!
rows.notes: Second brain-wave signature, not a second Ayato identity.

rows.en: What...?!
This is... Quon?!
Quon...?! Why...?
What do you intend to do, Commander?!

rows.notes: Silence retained.

rows.en: ...Soichi, what would you do?

rows.notes: Source wordless shocked reaction retained.

rows.en: ...We should follow procedure B-3 in the emergency manual.
rows.notes: B-3 is unchanged procedure identifier.

rows.en: That's the correct decision.
I'm asking you!
...We're going, Quon.
...Okay...
The RahXephon is leaving the area!
Switch to B-3 status immediately! ...That is acceptable, Commander Kunugi?
...The Foundation demands urgent action to resolve this situation. ...Send the Vermillion in pursuit immediately.
rows.notes: Foundation left source-short; urgency, resolution and immediate pursuit retained.

rows.en: Commander...!
...At present, only the Vermillion and #部隊名 can stop it.
rows.notes: Runtime squad placeholder preserved and measured at128px.

rows.en: They are not tools for striking down their comrades.
rows.notes: They refers to Vermillion and squad as resources; comrades refers to intended target.

rows.en: Comrades? Heh, it seems you can no longer even grasp the situation...
The Mulian Ayato Kamina will be tried for first-degree treason. ...You have no objections, I trust, Commander...?
rows.notes: Full source name preserved; first-degree treason retained as literal fictional charge.

rows.en: ...Was that all right, Shirow? Letting him go without telling him anything...
rows.notes: Rikudo addresses Watari by given name; him refers to departing Ayato. Source trailing second clause retained.

rows.en: ...I don't know...
...He's already old enough.
At least... At least as I am now...
rows.notes: Sentence fragment continues in row244; first-person subject retained in the next row.

rows.en: I have no right to tell him...
rows.notes: Completes row243: Watari disqualifies himself from telling Ayato, not Ayato from hearing it.

rows.en: ...Are you serious, Inspector Isshiki?
Of course, Captain Bright. I want you to sortie immediately... and make certain you recover the RahXephon and Quon Kisaragi.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: ...Why are you giving the orders?
...I have been granted special authority in situations like this, Lieutenant Hadhiyat.

rows.notes: All five original uses reviewed; silence stays silence.

rows.en: ...Our unit is not under TERRA's jurisdiction. I cannot comply with that request.
I have already made arrangements with the Federation military. You will receive formal orders shortly.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Or are you saying you cannot strike down an enemy, Colonel?
An enemy...? What evidence do you have to say that?
Come to think of it, you were not aware of this yet.
Inspector, that's...!!
rows.notes: Interrupted protest; no completed accusation added.

rows.en: Ayato Kamina is not human. He is a Mulian... our enemy.
What did you say!?
A-Ayato is...!?
rows.notes: Source trails off after Ayato; leaves the predicate unfinished.

rows.en: Your surprise is understandable. However, his blood has already tested positive for MU.
He's... a Mulian...!?
Exactly. It is only a matter of time before his blood turns from red to blue.
...What... what does that matter? Even if that boy is a Mulian, he's still one of us.
An alien like you has no right to interfere.
rows.notes: Preserves discriminatory alien dismissal at full strength.

rows.en: As I said, Ayato Kamina is a Mulian... He is not even human, let alone an Earthling.
Whatever his origins are, they don't matter to us!
Ah, I see. You were the one who said that to ingratiate yourself with the Baam... Kazuya Ryuzaki.
rows.notes: Isshiki sarcastically accuses Kazuya of ingratiating himself with the Baam; not legitimate diplomacy.

rows.en: What!? Say that again!
Stop it, Kazuya.
Kyoshiro!?
He's just like that Sakimori Miwa. Dealing with him is a waste of time.
rows.notes: Full source name Sakimori Miwa retained rather than adding glossary-short Commander title.

rows.en: Grr...!
Honestly, you amaze me. You have even taken in other beings like Ayato Kamina.
Hey, Mr. White Snake! Are you talking about Rom and the others!?
rows.notes: White Snake is sourced Isshiki nickname; sarcastic Mr. renders the mock honorific.

rows.en: Take it however you like. Still, there seem to be others among you with all manner of dubious origins...
Alien half-breeds, humans created through genetic engineering... cyborgs... and androids...
rows.notes: Deliberate list fragment preserved; half-breeds retains source hostility.
Silent reaction only; no invented words.

rows.en: I am even moved by your eccentric tastes... Pardon me, your generosity of spirit.
rows.notes: Mock self-correction from eccentric tastes to broad-mindedness retained.

rows.en: ...Inspector Isshiki, I understand your request.
Bright...!
A wise decision, Colonel. Should the target resist... it does not matter whether Ayato Kamina lives or dies.
Recovering the RahXephon and Quon Kisaragi remains the primary objective.
Are you saying you don't care what happens to Ayato!?
Of course. We have no need to treat him as a soldier, or to try him in court as a civilian.
rows.notes: Both exemptions from soldier treatment and civilian trial retained, without adding explicit execution procedure.

rows.en: ...Because he isn't human.
Be sure you do not exercise your own judgment. ...That concludes my instructions.
...Captain Bright, you can't really mean to do that to Ayato...!?
rows.notes: Source trails off on Ayato; action remains unspoken.

rows.en: ...Do you intend for us to handle this as we think best?
...Yes.
As you think best...?
That's right. We'll judge for ourselves. We who have fought alongside Ayato... will decide.
But then, Captain, you'll...!
rows.notes: Interrupted consequence remains unfinished; no punishment invented.

rows.en: It doesn't matter. Taking responsibility is my duty.
Captain...
All hands, prepare for launch immediately! We are going after the RahXephon!
All hands to Level 1 battle stations! I repeat, all hands to Level 1 battle stations!
...So the RahXephon's been located...!
rows.notes: Elvy reacts to the RahXephon having been located. Passive wording preserves an unnamed locator; capture does not mean successful reclamation.

rows.en: Elvy...
Captain Shitow...! Where have you been?
...I have a favor to ask of you.
rows.notes: Haruka asks Elvy for a favor; request direction explicitly preserved.

rows.en: ...What am I doing...?
...I'm doing something I can never undo... I know that.
But if we're not human...
rows.notes: Conditional source fragment remains open.

rows.en: ...We are human...
...We are human.
Quon...
...Could the RahXephon be your...?
rows.notes: Ayato addresses Quon. Source leaves possessed object after your unfinished; no noun or second unit identity supplied.
uncertain: Source leaves the possessed object unstated; retained as your... rather than inventing a unit or role.

rows.en: No. Mine is... different.
rows.notes: Mine retains omitted owned object; no additional unit or identity revealed.

rows.en: Ollin, let's keep flying like this.
Yeah...
D1 Aria...!
rows.notes: D1 treated as source operational label; Aria follows campaign term, not a invented Dolem name.

rows.en: A Dolem...! Is it trying to lure us...?
...It's inviting us...
rows.notes: Dolem invitation replies to row313; restores contextual subject and object.

rows.en: ...Everyone's here.
Captain, the RahXephon is in sight!
All units, sortie immediately.
Captain, all units have finished launching.
Understood. All units, hold your positions.
Stand by? You think that's the best way to handle this?
Yes. ...Lieutenant Hadhiyat, I'll leave it to you to call out to Ayato Kamina.
...Understood...!
Ayato... Are you planning to go inside TOKYO JUPITER...!?
...The divine bird-man... It has come to see us off...
rows.notes: Quon addresses Reideen symbolically; restored its subject from 325-326.

rows.en: See us off...? Raideen has?
rows.notes: Echoed question is a deliberate fragment. Coordinator script enforces Akurasu/main Raideen spelling; no meaning or compression change, initial draft retained.

rows.en: ...Raideen isn't reacting... Does it somehow know what RahXephon is planning to do...?
rows.notes: Coordinator script enforces Akurasu/main Raideen spelling; no meaning or compression change, initial draft retained.

rows.en: D1 confirmed ahead of RahXephon!
! That's the one from before...!
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment; same Dolem as earlier encounter.

rows.en: Is that Dolem going to attack Ayato...!?
No. I think it's probably...
rows.notes: Ple Two is interrupted before explaining the Dolem purpose.

rows.en: ...Kamina, can you hear me?
Elvy...!
rows.notes: Address-only exclamation preserved.

rows.en: Return to base immediately. ...This is no warning. This is your final ultimatum.
A final ultimatum...? So... what happens if I don't obey?
...I'll attack you.
Elvy, you can't seriously mean...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate incredulous trailing question.

rows.en: ...That one distorts Ollin's tone... I don't like it...
rows.notes: That one refers to the Dolem ahead; Quon describes effect on Ollin tone without specifying mechanism.

rows.en: Come back, Kamina...

rows.notes: Ayato's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Ayato, you mustn't come back now!
! Haruka!?
rows.notes: Address-only exclamation preserved.

rows.en: Shitow! What are you doing!?
H-Haruka! Why are you in a Vermillion!?
rows.notes: Sister address rendered as Haruka in natural English; no additional relationship invented.

rows.en: Ayato, if you come back now, you'll...!
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete warning.

rows.en: Stop it, Haruka! You'll get more than confinement for this!
But one day, surely...!
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete insistence; preserves unstated subject and event rather than completing the warning.
uncertain: Source leaves the eventual event and subject unstated; preserved omission.

rows.en: ...I... I want to know the truth... I need to know.
About myself, about Mom... about TOKYO JUPITER... That's all I want.
rows.notes: Fragment list completes the desire stated in 346.

rows.en: What good will knowing all that do you now!?
...I think I understand how Ayato feels.
What!?
rows.notes: Elvy reacts to Quon's warning.

rows.en: I lived my life without knowing who I really was, too...
But in the end, I'm glad I learned the truth. At least, I am now...
rows.notes: At least now qualifies Masato opinion without inventing future doubt.

rows.en: So you're saying we should let Kamina go!? If he goes over to the other side...!
rows.notes: Threat consequence remains deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: The Dolem!?
This is bad! RahXephon is going to...!!
rows.notes: RahXephon consequence remains unfinished.

rows.en: I knew it! The Dolem came to pick up Ayato...!
Huh!?
Are you saying they want to welcome Ayato into TOKYO JUPITER!?
That's right. Otherwise, they wouldn't have come out there.
If that's what they're after, we'd better do something, hadn't we!?
Yes. If he goes inside, we won't be able to follow him...!
It's all right... Ayato will come back. I know he will.
He'll come back...? Are you sure?
I think so too, Mari.
Akira...
rows.notes: Address-only fragment preserved.

rows.en: What proof do you have!?
Ayato came back with Shinji that time, too. That's why... I trust him.

rows.notes: Silent startled reaction preserved.

rows.en: ...Nahel Argama to all units. Intercept the Dolem immediately.
Captain, are you sure we can let Ayato Kamina go?
Yes. It seems we're not the ones who need to discover the truth.
rows.notes: Ayato is the one who needs truth; Bright says their side does not without exposing hidden facts.

rows.en: So it's too soon for us to learn what's inside Pandora's box... Understood.
rows.notes: Pandora image preserved.

rows.en: They're starting to fight...! What am I supposed to do...!?
But if this goes on, everyone will...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished concern for companions.

rows.en: It'll be all right... So, shall we go?
Is that your answer, Kamina!!
Ayato...!
rows.notes: Address-only exclamation preserved.

rows.en: All units, stop pursuing RahXephon... Please intercept the enemy units at once.
I believe in you, Ayato... I know you'll come back to us...
rows.notes: Japanese second clause is dependent on belief; English combines within same row.

rows.en: Ayato... I'll go too... So I can meet you in Tokyo once again...
rows.notes: Haruka plans to follow, not accompany already departed Ayato.

rows.en: Ayato... I don't know what you'll find in there...
But I believe you'll overcome it, whatever it is...
...I'm going home. I am...
rows.notes: Reversed emphatic source order preserved as trailing self-reiteration.

rows.en: La-la-la, la-la-la-la-la, la-la-la... La-la-la-la-la-la-la, la-la-la-la-la-la-la...
rows.notes: Sung vocables transliterated; syllable groups preserved; also used s0710:597.

rows.en: A quantum corridor is forming...!
rows.notes: Quantum corridor uses literal common noun; Akurasu MX BGM and RahXephon pages corroborate franchise phrase as music title only, not licensed dialogue terminology.
uncertain: Exact dialogue technical naming remains unverified; Akurasu corroboration is limited to music-title usage.

rows.en: ...Ayato...!
rows.notes: Address-only exclamation preserved.

rows.en: ...RahXephon is going...!
...Farewell, bird-man of the blue forest... Guardian god of Mu on this side...
rows.notes: Symbolic address to Reideen; blue forest and this-side Mu preserved.
uncertain: Descriptive bird-man of the blue forest is literal imagery, not a verified proper title. Reideen referent settled by 324-326.

rows.notes: Akira reacts silently; exact exclamation preserved.

rows.en: May the eternal radiance of the stars be with you...
rows.notes: Ceremonial blessing preserves eternal stars image.

rows.en: RahXephon's signal is gone! The quantum corridor has closed!
rows.notes: Quantum corridor uses literal common noun; Akurasu MX BGM and RahXephon pages corroborate franchise phrase as music title only, not licensed dialogue terminology.
uncertain: Exact dialogue technical naming remains unverified; Akurasu corroboration is limited to music-title usage.

rows.en: So RahXephon has gone to TOKYO JUPITER...
rows.notes: Bright observes RahXephon departure; no addressee added.
Silence serves both scene-specific uses without added interpretation.

rows.en: Megumi, report to TERRA. We've lost RahXephon... We're continuing to intercept the enemy.
rows.notes: Report order and quoted report content preserved without quotes.

rows.en: Y-yes, sir!
rows.notes: Stammered acknowledgment retained.

rows.en: The die is cast... The rest is up to you, Ayato.
D1 and D2's signals have disappeared!
Good... All units, return immediately.
! The Vermillion is...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished detection report.

rows.en: Haruka, Elvy! What's wrong!?
...Let's go after RahXephon, Elvy.
Go after it? Of course...!
rows.notes: Elvy realization of Vermillion function explained by next row.

rows.en: Vermillion has a function that lets it break through the absolute barrier.
You can't use the TDD unit with someone in everyday clothes aboard.
rows.notes: Elvy addresses Haruka, whose ordinary clothes lack the protection for the TDD unit; someone refers to Haruka herself.

rows.en: Would you stop treating me like an amateur? This isn't my first time inside TOKYO JUPITER.
...It's going to be pretty rough, you know?
...I know what I'm getting into.
All right.
...Elvy.
What is it?
...Thank you...
...Heh, a little late for that. Vermillion to Nahel Argama. Activating Piercer Sequence.
rows.notes: Wry dismissal of thanks, followed by radio procedural speech. Piercer Sequence provisional; glossary escalation sent.
uncertain: Piercer Sequence absent from glossary; provisional direct rendering.

rows.en: All contact, blackout.
rows.notes: Procedural callout retained as clipped source noun phrase.

rows.en: Don't tell me they're...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished realization; the next Ruri line supplies entering TOKYO JUPITER.

rows.en: It looks like they're going inside TOKYO JUPITER.
This is Bright. ...I wish you both luck.
I'm sorry, Captain...
H-Haruka...
rows.notes: Sister address adapted to natural English Haruka; stutter retained.

rows.en: Don't worry, Megumi. I'll come back. I promise...
Okay...
Haruka, Elvy... be careful.
We will...
rows.notes: Reply to Vega wishing both women care; restored we.

rows.en: When we get back safely, let's have a drink with Major Katsuragi and the others.
...All right.
Piercer Sequence, activating Phase 1.
rows.notes: Clipped activation callout; Piercer Sequence provisional.
uncertain: Piercer Sequence absent from glossary; provisional direct rendering.

rows.en: T minus 60. Piercer Field Resonance, contact. Activating Phase 2.
rows.notes: Technical callout is clipped; Piercer Field Resonance provisional.
uncertain: Piercer Field Resonance absent from glossary; provisional direct rendering.

rows.en: Stochastic resonance boundary breached. Field generator at maximum output. ...Here we go, Haruka.
rows.notes: Scientific component stochastic resonance follows primary academic bilingual terminology; whole fictional boundary licensed wording remains provisional. All actions preserved.
uncertain: Full fictional stochastic resonance boundary wording is provisional; scientific component sourced by root.

rows.en: Yes...!
Resonance on. Beginning free fall!
Vermillion has entered the absolute barrier...!
Sis...!
rows.notes: Megumi addresses older sister Haruka; relationship explicit source and glossary.

rows.en: Everyone... please be safe...!
rows.notes: Prayer/wish retains source ellipsis.

rows.en: ...This is...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished location recognition.

rows.en: ...Where am I...?
...Th-that's right... I came to Tokyo...
rows.notes: Interrupted recollection retains trailing ellipsis.

rows.en: Where's... Quon...? And where's Mom...?
...Isn't she right there?
rows.notes: Maya is the visible referent, settled by following temple scene; she restored.
uncertain: Read she as Maya after the scene reveals her; preceding question also names Quon.

rows.en: Huh!? Mishima...!
The person you want to see is right there...
rows.notes: Trailing source pause retained, English predicate restored.
Ayato reacts silently; double exclamation preserved.

rows.en: ...Xephon is currently stationary inside Seon Temple. There are no signs of petrification, either.
rows.notes: Seon Temple follows glossary despite its documented unverified status.

rows.en: Lady Maya...
rows.notes: Respectful title retained as Lady because this is hierarchy address.
Wordless shock retained.
Broken mother address retained.

rows.en: ...What is it, Kuki?
Quon, who arrived aboard Xephon, is in poor condition. She went a long time without wearing her Life Module...
rows.notes: Explains why Quon is ill; cause ends with source trailing ellipsis.

rows.en: I know the cause. Report only on the measures you've taken and their effectiveness.
Yes...
Mom...
rows.notes: Mother address is a deliberate fragment.

rows.en: Is this... the truth...? Was it really true after all...?
...So this is... Tokyo...
Look, up in the sky...!
rows.notes: Deictic warning is deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: The Dolem from before...!
rows.notes: Deliberate identification fragment.

rows.en: Are you saying... it's watching over Tokyo...!?
Why aren't the people here bothered by that...?
I couldn't see anything like that before...
rows.notes: Haruka contrasts her earlier visit; I restored.

rows.en: Yeah...
Has Mu's control over their minds grown stronger than before...?
rows.notes: their minds refers to Tokyo residents, not named individual.

rows.en: ...Haruka, do you have any idea where Kamina might go?
I do.
Can you show me the way?
Yes... This is my city, after all. I used to live here...
rows.notes: Personal memory trailing off preserved.

rows.en: ...Can I ask you something?
What is it?
Why are you so hung up on Kamina?
...Because he's someone precious to me...
rows.notes: Ayato is the referent established by preceding question; male gender sourced glossary.

rows.en: ...Quon...
rows.notes: Address fragment retained.

rows.en: ...I'm just... a little tired... Don't worry... I'm fine.
You're fine...?
rows.notes: Echo of Quon claiming she is fine; elliptical challenge retained.

rows.en: M... Mom...
rows.notes: Broken mother address retained.

rows.en: Welcome home, Ayato. You've finally come back to me.
...Maya... let me... hear your voice.
What would hearing my voice do for you?
...I see...
...Naim mema nekpa...
rows.notes: Mulian utterance kept as phonetic romanization; no meaning invented.
uncertain: Untranslated Mulian phrase romanization needs canonical English confirmation.

rows.en: ...Espa masa...
rows.notes: Mulian utterance kept as phonetic romanization; no meaning invented.
uncertain: Untranslated Mulian phrase romanization needs canonical English confirmation.

rows.en: I'll come again later. ...Ayato, go on home first. I'll be there soon, too.
Oh! Kamina!!
Asahina... and Torigai...!
...It's been a while, Ayato.
...Y-yeah...
You seem... different, Kamina.
Do I... really?
He couldn't change that much in just one month.
rows.notes: Mamoru responds to Hiroko about Ayato; third-person he restored, not direct you.

rows.en: One month...?
rows.notes: Echo question fragment retained.

rows.en: ...It's been six months on the outside...
The teachers at school haven't said a thing... Nobody seems to care at all that you disappeared...
rows.notes: Continues into next packet row480. Both teachers and other people preserved; trailing off kept.

rows.en: I've felt something was wrong, all this time...!
rows.notes: Hiroko admits prolonged unease; Japanese sentence trails, retained with ellipsis.

rows.en: Asahina...
rows.notes: Surname address retained; identical body serves two original uses.

rows.en: I wanted to see you again, Kamina! I wanted to see you and ask you...!
rows.notes: Hiroko addresses Kamina; attempted question deliberately left unfinished.

rows.en: But I... I don't even know what I should ask you...!
rows.notes: Hiroko admits she cannot identify what she needs to ask; full subject/verb restored.

rows.en: How can that even happen!?
rows.notes: Incredulous question refers to inability to identify forgotten information.

rows.en: ...Give it a rest. You're worrying too much about all this weird stuff.
Ayato, you were just away on a trip for some family business, right?
Huh? Oh, y-yeah... Oh, right, um... What are they saying at school about Mishima disappearing?
rows.notes: Ayato evades Mamoru then changes topic to disappeared Mishima.

rows.en: Mishima...?
Yes, Reika Mishima. Our classmate.
rows.notes: Full Reika Mishima name retained followed by classmate identification.

rows.en: Who's that?
Mishima... Mishima... Have I heard that somewhere...?
rows.notes: Hiroko struggles to recall surname; tentative incomplete recollection made natural in English.

rows.en: ...Never mind. Don't worry about it.
...See? See!? I'm forgetting something important!
rows.notes: Forgetting important information retained without inventing lost-memory mechanism.

rows.en: I feel like I've heard that name before!
Hiroko, give it a rest!
Tell me, am I the one who's strange!? Or is it everyone else!? Tell me, Ayato!!
rows.notes: Hiroko contrasts her own strangeness with everyone else; no added accusation of insanity.

rows.en: ...Sorry, Asahina. I... I have to go.
Ayato!!

rows.notes: Source silence retained; omission flagged.

rows.en: ...Why did we come to a place like this? Is Kamina here?
This is the middle school I went to... I have so many memories here...
We went to school together, studied together, grew flowers together...
rows.notes: We refers to Haruka and Kamina, as settled by confession504. Trailing memories retained.

rows.en: ...So that's what this was about.
I loved Kamina...
rows.notes: Past affection preserved; present state is queried in following row.

rows.en: Do you still love him?
...I'm just an older sister figure, twelve whole years older than him... That's all.
rows.notes: Older sister figure is relational metaphor, not a claim of biological siblinghood. Twelve-year gap and emphatic whole retained.

rows.en: ...Oh, great. You really took me for a ride too, huh? ...Come on, let's go.
rows.notes: Elvy recognizes Haruka maneuvered her into search; took me for a ride preserves colloquial complaint.

rows.en: Huh?
I'm already in this with you. That's what we came here for, isn't it?
rows.notes: Boarded-ship idiom rendered committed involvement rather than literal boat; rhetorical shared-purpose question retained.

rows.en: ...This is reality... This is the world I lived in... Tokyo...
rows.notes: Ayato confronted with Tokyo reality; no imported facts about external world.

rows.en: This world existed for you, Ayato. It was created for you alone.
For me?
But you went outside to become a true Instrumentalist. So this world changed.
rows.notes: True Instrumentalist uses Akurasu-derived glossary; departure is cause of changed world.

rows.en: It no longer needed to fit you. You understand, don't you?
...Mom... What exactly are you?
A being humanity calls a Mulian... But most of us still can't come out to this side...
rows.notes: Maya identifies herself as Mulian; majority cannot reach this side. No invented universe name.

rows.en: Only a handful of us could be salvaged from the other side...
rows.notes: Salvage metaphor preserved as source; handful is only small number.

rows.en: People with blue blood... For now, we can only keep existing by synchronizing with a Dolem or a human on this side...
rows.notes: Blue blood / continued existence / synchronization / Dolem or this-side human all retained; nominal exposition restored as full second clause.

rows.en: Th-then...
rows.notes: Stammered unfinished inference retained.

rows.en: Yes, Mulians are people too. We're human. We're not monsters.
...Am I a Mulian too?
Yes, you are.
Was Dad one too? You said he died when I was little.
rows.notes: Dad question preserves both claimed death and Ayato childhood timing.

rows.en: ...I love you, Ayato.
rows.notes: Maya avoids answering paternity question; love declaration retained without resolving ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Then put on what you normally wear.
rows.notes: Ayato demands normal clothes; response526 specifies Mulian leader attire, not casual clothes.

rows.en: What...?
What you wear as the leader of the Mulians, Mom...!
Their blood is changing color... Everyone's becoming strange...
rows.notes: Hiroko thought; blood color change and growing strangeness retained without adding transformation lore.

rows.en: But... No one thinks it's strange... I'm scared, Ayato... I'm scared...!
rows.notes: Hiroko thought; nobody recognizing strangeness contrasted with fear.

rows.en: Who the hell are you!?

rows.notes: Surprise serves guard encounter and later RahXephon realization; neutral interjection works in both.

rows.en: What are you doing here?
...Leave that girl alone.
rows.notes: Unknown speaker label stays ???; spoken instruction allows girl through without exposing Mamoru early.

rows.en: Torigai!?
Hiroko... Why did you come here?
What about you, Torigai!? Why...!? Why are you at Kamina's house!?
...Who is this woman?
Someone from the military...!? Why is he at Kamina's house!?
rows.notes: Hiroko thought; military person is visibly/next-line Kuki, male in sourced glossary. Question restored with he.

rows.en: She's got nothing to do with this.
But...!
You have something to report to Lady Maya, don't you? Get inside already.
rows.notes: Mamoru orders Kuki to Maya; Lady Maya preserves reverent leader address without new military rank.

rows.en: Tch...
...Torigai... Who are you, really?
I'm... I'm me.
rows.notes: Evasive self-identification rather than explanatory identity revelation.

rows.en: Have you been lying to me all this time...!?
If I had, things would have been a lot easier...!
rows.notes: Counterfactual easier if he had been deceiving her; no invented love confession.
Reaction punctuation only; omission flagged.

rows.en: Hiroko... I... I...!
rows.notes: Stalled first-person declaration deliberately left unfinished.

rows.en: Hey... No!
rows.notes: Hiroko objects to approach; no invented physical action.

rows.en: Hiroko, forget about Ayato! Come with me!
Nooo!!
Gah!!
rows.notes: Pain cry Gah, no added description.

rows.en: ! Your blood...!!
rows.notes: Source exclaimed blood fragment retained; your supplied from visibly bleeding Mamoru response554.

rows.en: H-Hiroko...!
N-no...! Stay awaaay!!
Wait, Hiroko! Where are you going!?
...A forest of doubt... the hour of awakening... A boy's breath shines only in platinum...
rows.notes: Quon poetic prophecy remains surreal and fragmented; no invented object completing hour-of-awakening phrase.
uncertain: Poetic opening leaves the grammatical relationship between forest and hour unresolved; retained as fragment. Platinum imagery kept literally; no invented referent for boy.

rows.en: ...Lady Maya.
What is it?
The Xephon has activated and is acting on its own in ways we did not anticipate.
rows.notes: Kuki to Maya: unexpected independent Xephon activity; autonomous mechanism retained.

rows.en: Then use Allegretto and Metronome to stop it.
rows.notes: Maya orders Kuki to stop Xephon using both named Dolems.

rows.en: Yes, ma'am!
rows.notes: Kuki acknowledges military order; female superior established Maya profile.

rows.en: And... you have something else to report, don't you?
Y-yes... Another dimensional egg has appeared in the city.
rows.notes: Another dimensional egg, not another dimension; city appearance explicit.
uncertain: Dimensional egg is literal provisional English; root Akurasu search no exact entry, Bandai ep23 confirms Japanese concept only, licensed English unverified.

rows.en: Could that be the other...?
rows.notes: Source deliberately trails before identity of other object; no guessed Xephon supplied.

rows.en: I did not ask for your opinion.
I-I'm terribly sorry.
...She is singing. Kuki, send someone to the hospital.
rows.notes: Source she retained without adding identity; Maya sends hospital personnel through Kuki.

rows.en: I... I understand.
...Ayato, I am going back to the Government-General. You...
rows.notes: Maya addresses Ayato and trails at You; Government-General follows sourced designation stem.

rows.en: ! Where did you go, Ayato...?
I... can't stay here...! Not here anymore...!
rows.notes: Ayato thinking to himself that he cannot remain in Tokyo; repeated fragment retained.

rows.en: Kamina...?
rows.notes: Surname Kamina as source, honorific dropped.

rows.en: ! Asahina!!
rows.notes: Surname Asahina as source, no added Hiroko.

rows.en: A-ah... Kamina...!
rows.notes: Semantic review: Natural English stutter/relieved cry in place of mechanically repeated ah interjection; no meaning omitted.

rows.en: W-what happened, Asahina...? You're hurt so badly...
rows.notes: Asks cause and states severe injury; no inferred attacker or injury mechanism.

rows.en: Look... at my blood... It's red, isn't it? Right? It's red, right...?
rows.notes: Hiroko asks Ayato to confirm blood is red; repeated pleas preserved.

rows.en: ...Y-yeah... It's red...
rows.notes: Ayato confirms red blood; no objective explanation why blood changed.

rows.en: Thank goodness...! Thank goodness...
Asahina, I... can't stay here anymore. I mustn't stay here.
rows.notes: Ayato says cannot remain and ought not remain; both meanings preserved.

rows.en: Then neither can I...!
rows.notes: Hiroko echoes both inability/not-belonging; explicit first-person parallel.

rows.en: I'm sorry... Asahina, I...
rows.notes: Source trails at I after apology; not completed.

rows.en: No! Take me with you! Take me with you, too!!
rows.notes: Hiroko begs Ayato to take her along; direction explicit.

rows.en: A-Asahina...!?
Don't leave me alone...! Please... I'm begging you...!!
rows.notes: Plea not to leave her alone, not instruction she is leaving him.

rows.en: ...Asahina...
...Asahina, this way!
Kamina... I...
rows.notes: Source trails at I; not completed.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Ayato's surprise serves both Kim's bereavement and Reika's summons at use280.

rows.en: ...I... I think I've been waiting...
rows.notes: Hiroko thinks she had been waiting; object supplied by next row591, kept unfinished.

rows.en: ...I've been waiting for you, Kamina... For you to... someday... me...
rows.notes: Deliberate uncompleted object phrase: she waited for Kamina to someday do something to/for her; no rescue or romance verb invented.
uncertain: Source intentionally omits action verb; matching incomplete English argument structure is unusually fragmented but no completing action invented.

rows.en: W-what is that...!?
RahXephon...!

rows.notes: Ayato addresses RahXephon; source leaves action toward him unstated, two argument fragments retained.
uncertain: Source intentionally omits action verb; matching incomplete English argument structure is unusually fragmented but no completing action invented.

rows.en: ...This isn't where we belong... This isn't the place for us to return to...!
rows.notes: Belonging and return/home destination are distinct clauses retained. Semantic review: Uses literal return-destination meaning without making Tokyo an explicitly named home.

rows.en: I'm leaving, going outside... with you... So please, answer me...!
rows.notes: Ayato tells RahXephon he will leave together with it and asks it to respond; not offer that it count on him.

rows.en: RaaahXeeephooon!!
rows.notes: Drawn-out shout localized with repeated vowels, canonical RahXephon elsewhere unchanged.
Hiroko refers to RahXephon and their group; source leaves the transporting action unstated; retained exact unfinished argument fragments.
uncertain: Source intentionally omits action verb; matching incomplete English argument structure is unusually fragmented but no completing action invented.

rows.en: ...Yes... Let's go...
! The RahXephon...!!
rows.notes: Source RahXephon subject trails without predicate; no invented action before602.

rows.en: Nooo! Ayato!!
It opened a corridor!? Is it going outside!?
rows.notes: Elvy comments on RahXephon corridor creation and impending exit; it refers unit, no gender inference.

rows.en: Ayato! Ayato's leaving!!
rows.notes: Haruka alarmed Ayato is leaving; future/current event, not already gone.
Pure shock retained; no slap narration added.

rows.en: ...He's gone... Kamina...!
rows.notes: Haruka now says departed; surname Kamina preserved in cry.

rows.en: Shitow!
rows.notes: Source surname Shitow without first-name expansion.

rows.en: He's gone...!
Pull yourself together, Haruka Shitow! What will we do if you don't keep it together!?
rows.notes: Source full name Haruka Shitow, then demands composure; no title added.
Haruka reacts in shocked silence; punctuation-only source preserved.

rows.en: We don't have time to waste! We're going outside, too!!
rows.notes: Elvy orders immediate exit for their group.

rows.en: Elvy...!
If we stay here, we'll just become prey for the Dolems!
rows.notes: Remain here implies both women prey to Dolems; we restored.

rows.en: Besides, if Kamina's gone outside, there are plenty of ways we can look for him, aren't there!?
rows.notes: Elvy reassures many possible ways to find Kamina outside; no invented specific search plan.

rows.en: Y-yes...!
Here we go! Activate Piercer Sequence! Field generator, maximum output!
rows.notes: Activation command: sourced literal Piercer Sequence; field generator generic equipment noun, maximum output retained.
uncertain: Piercer Sequence is direct source loanword compound; independently licensed exact English unverified.

rows.en: ...Ayato...!
rows.notes: Haruka inner name-call, source thought brackets used in fit.

rows.en: ...I see. She disappeared along with that egg, then.
rows.notes: Maya confirms explicit she disappeared with egg; identity not added.

rows.en: Yes...
That's not all. The Xephon and TERRA's mobile weapons also went outside the absolute barrier.
rows.notes: Both Xephon and TERRA mobile weapons left absolute barrier; no singularization of weapons.

rows.en: Please order a pursuit at once. That mechanical god is out there, too.
rows.notes: Kuki asks Maya for immediate pursuit order; mechanical god remains undesignated, no Raideen substituted.

rows.en: ...The Star of Ra Mu still does not shine... It is trying to discern Ixtli's guidance and Ollin's future...
rows.notes: Immediate subject Star of Ra Mu provisionally carried into It; source does not repeat subject; retain discernment of both Ixtli guidance and Ollin future. Semantic review: Future follows where Ollin is headed without importing metaphysical fate.
uncertain: It provisionally refers to nearest explicit subject Star of Ra Mu; source omits repeated subject, previous mechanical god could be broader personified referent.

rows.en: Lady Maya!
rows.notes: Lady Maya follows explicit honorific addressed to established female superior.

rows.en: Don't speak to me now. ...I'll kill you.
rows.notes: Maya threatens to kill Kuki if interrupted; full killing threat retained.
